description: This file defines the strategy and validation logic for Kubernetes NetworkPolicy objects, including creation, update, validation, and warning generation.

classes.name: networkPolicyStrategy
classes.description: Implements verification and validation logic for NetworkPolicies, including creation, update, and warning generation.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Returns true indicating NetworkPolicies are namespace scoped.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Initializes a new NetworkPolicy object before creation, setting its generation to 1.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Updates the NetworkPolicy object before saving, incrementing generation if the spec has changed.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a new NetworkPolicy object using Kubernetes validation functions.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Generates warnings related to the NetworkPolicy object upon creation.

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes the object after validation (no implementation).

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Indicates that creation on update is not allowed for NetworkPolicies.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to an existing NetworkPolicy object.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Generates warnings related to the NetworkPolicy object upon update.

methods.name: AllowUnconditionalUpdate
methods.description: Indicates that unconditional updates are allowed for NetworkPolicies.

methods.name: networkPolicyWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings for CIDR fields in NetworkPolicy ingress and egress rules.
